knowledge:
- key_parameters: fcol=The feature metadata column name containing marker annotations (defaults to "markers") ;; times=The number of runs/replications for cross-validation or optimization (e.g., 50 or 100) ;; xval=The number of folds for cross-validation (typically 5) ;; th=An explicit weight matrix for transfer learning generated via thetas ;; k=The number of nearest neighbours to consider for KNN or kNN-TL (e.g., c(3, 3)) ;; method=The dimensionality reduction method in plot2D (e.g., "PCA", "t-SNE", "UMAP", "scree") ;; perplexity=The input parameter for t-SNE balancing global and local aspects (suggested range 5 to 50) ;; n_neighbors=The number of nearest neighbours for UMAP embedding
- alternatives: pRolocGUI=An interactive web-based Shiny application for exploring spatial proteomics data, preferred for interactive visualization ;; TAGM-MAP / TAGM-MCMC=Bayesian generative mixture models, preferred when proteome-wide uncertainty quantitation is required ;; phenoDisco=A semi-supervised novelty detection algorithm, preferred when discovering new phenotypes/organelles from unlabelled data ;; lpsvm-tl-code repository=An external repository implementing SVM-TL, preferred if SVM-based transfer learning is specifically required as it is not yet in the main pRoloc package
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing mass-spectrometry-based spatial proteomics data (such as LOPIT, PCP, or discrete fractions) to assign proteins of unknown localization to sub-cellular niches based on their distribution profiles across fractions.
- pitfalls: Using too low a k value (e.g., k=1) in KNN leads to over-fitting and poor generalization to new data ;; Relying on online servers for pulling auxiliary data (like GO terms via biomaRt) does not guarantee reproducibility over time, so users should save and store versioned annotations (e.g., using GO.db) ;; Empty strings in marker annotations are not treated as unknown, so the explicit tag "unknown" must be used for unlabelled proteins ;; Supervised LDA plots should not be used for exploratory data analysis or quality control as they maximize class separation by design, so unsupervised PCA should be used instead ;; Accuracy scores from parameter optimization only reflect performance on well-separated marker clusters, not necessarily the entire proteome

workflows.name: supervised_classification_svm
workflows.intent: Optimize SVM parameters and predict protein sub-cellular localization using supervised machine learning.
workflows.stages: 1. Import quantitative and metadata files into an MSnSet object using readMSnSet or readMSnSet2 ;; 2. Normalize the expression data to sum to 1 using normalise ;; 3. Optimize SVM hyperparameters (cost and sigma) via grid search and cross-validation using svmOptimisation ;; 4. Train the classifier and predict localization of unknown proteins using svmClassification
workflows.code:
tan2009r1 <- readMSnSet(exprsFile = f1, featureDataFile = f2, phenoDataFile = f3, sep = ",")
itraqnorm <- normalise(itraqdata, method = "sum")
params <- svmOptimisation(tan2009r1, times = 10, xval = 5, verbose = FALSE)
tan2009r1 <- svmClassification(tan2009r1, params)

workflows.name: nearest_neighbour_transfer_learning
workflows.intent: Combine primary experimental spatial proteomics data with auxiliary data (e.g., GO terms) using weighted k-nearest neighbour transfer learning to predict sub-cellular localization.
input: auxiliary_data.csv (auxiliary annotation data, e.g., binary GO terms)
workflows.stages: 1. Define weight combinations using thetas ;; 2. Optimize class-specific weights using knntlOptimisation ;; 3. Extract the best parameters using getParams ;; 4. Apply the optimal weights and classify unlabelled proteins using knntlClassification ;; 5. Extract predictions and scores using getPredictions
workflows.code:
th <- thetas(length(m), length.out=4)
topt <- knntlOptimisation(andy2011, andy2011goCC, th = th, k = c(3, 3), fcol = "markers.tl", times = 50)
getParams(topt)
andy2011 <- knntlClassification(andy2011, andy2011goCC, bestTheta = bw, k = c(3, 3), fcol = "markers.tl")
andy2011 <- getPredictions(andy2011, fcol = "knntl")
